title: A presheaf map sheafifies to an isomorphism iff it is locally injective and locally surjective
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] and $\varphi:\mathcal P\to\mathcal Q$ a morphism of presheaves of abelian groups on $\mathcal C$, with sheafification $\varphi^\#:\mathcal P^\#\to\mathcal Q^\#$ [def-weil-pbc-sheafification]. Call $\varphi$ *locally injective* if for every object $U$ and $s,t\in\mathcal P(U)$ with $\varphi(s)=\varphi(t)$ there is a covering $\{U_i\to U\}$ with $s|_{U_i}=t|_{U_i}$ for all $i$, and *locally surjective* if for every $U$ and $t\in\mathcal Q(U)$ there are a covering $\{U_i\to U\}$ and $s_i\in\mathcal P(U_i)$ with $\varphi(s_i)=t|_{U_i}$. Then $\varphi^\#$ is an isomorphism of abelian sheaves if and only if $\varphi$ is locally injective and locally surjective.

mathlib_match.how: a few Mathlib lemmas, one per clause: for A = AddCommGrpCat the instance at LocallyBijective.lean:153 gives J.WEqualsLocallyBijective A, so W_iff_isLocallyBijective (LocallyBijective.lean:114) says J.W f <-> Presheaf.IsLocallyInjective J f and Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective J f, and W_iff (Sites/Localization.lean:80) says J.W f <-> IsIso ((presheafToSheaf J A).map f), i.e. f^# is an isomorphism. Mathlib's IsLocallyInjective (equalizer sieve of s,t covering when f s = f t) and IsLocallySurjective (image sieve of t covering) are the node's conditions for the Grothendieck topology generated by the coverings of the site (a sieve covers iff it contains a covering family).
